decisions.reason: The plug-ins have their own dedicated web page, which shows a visible commitment and investment, and they fit the firm's core GIS integration business, so management will persist with them.

The digital twin service is only mentioned on the website, but it fits the firm's strategic direction toward building data and smart city work, so weak early results can still be blamed on a young market.
Authentication and identity delegation underpins the firm's announced identity offering and is tied to the Identity Service launch, so dropping it would undercut a public commitment.
An open GIS development framework draws on substantial sunk development effort and is central to the firm's GIS platform identity, so it is retained despite its modest web presence.

The firm publicly announced its new Identity Service as enabling seamless integration of GeoIT applications, which creates strong public commitment and a need to justify the launch, so it will be kept.
